static_traits.name: Chen Anran
static_traits.social_status: Has several friends who could offer support, but not yet discussed Anxiety and self-consciousness issues with them
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received before; no similar psychological problems have emerged before
static_traits.language_features: Tense but cooperative, clear expression, able to identify and discuss automatic thoughts, able to propose alternative Interpretations; steady speech rate, fairly good logic

basic_info.main_problem: I always feel others judge me negatively because of my height, especially in public places like cinemas, which makes me extremely self-conscious and Anxious.
basic_info.core_demands: This self-consciousness and Anxiety are starting to affect my daily functioning and social interactions.
growth_experiences: Excessive self-consciousness and Anxiety began in adolescence and worsened in recent months; the client believes societal pressure to 'blend in, not stand out' causes their distress, making them feel more watched and judged in public places (e.g., cinemas), leading to intense Anxiety and Avoids socializing.

core_beliefs: I am not accepted by others because my height stands out
If I attract attention, I will be evaluated negatively

special_situations.event: Worries about blocking the view of the back row when watching a film in the cinema
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my height affects others, it is my fault, and others will dislike me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: In public, tries to minimize presence and stay quiet, choosing remote seats or reducing going out
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must hate me and think I am in their way

special_situations.event: In crowded public places, feeling that I become the focus of attention
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I stand out, I will be negatively judged
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids crowded places, standing or sitting by walls or corners to lower their sense of presence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone is looking at me and does not like me

special_situations.event: When queuing or seated while out with friends, worries about taking up too much space
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I should not stand out and must not trouble others
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeps stiff and quiet, curls the body as much as possible, reduces movement
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I take up too much space; others will be dissatisfied

special_situations.event: Feeling intense Anxiety before Attending social activities, Anticipation negative judgment
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I go into a crowd, I will definitely be judged and disliked
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding social activities in advance to avoid possible embarrassment and judgment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Going will only be awful; everyone will dislike me

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted and participate in social life at ease without being judged negatively
core_conflict.fear: Fears being humiliated, excluded, or disliked for standing out
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of safety by lowering presence and avoiding crowds
Avoiding triggering others' negative judgment to reduce shame and Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: A conspicuous person who may disturb others and is easily judged
object_relations.object_representation: Critical others or crowds who become dissatisfied and judge negatively

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When in public settings or when pressed by the counselor about the evidence and sources of these worries
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting discomfort as 'societal pressure demands not standing out', to ease self-blame and Anxiety (transference: using social norms as external Interpretation)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use rationalized social-norm Interpretations, in an even tone, restraining emotional expression, downplaying direct exploration of personal shame and Fear.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When in a crowd and subjectively feeling watched
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others are dissatisfied with or dislike me, attributing inner criticism and insecurity to others (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expressing by guessing others' feelings, e.g., 'they must be very unhappy', in a tense tone, with less self-disclosure, avoiding checking objective evidence.

manifestations: Believing society Demands 'blending in, not standing out', internalized as the self-constraint of 'I should not stand out'
Avoiding socializing in public places, hard to enjoy outings like movies with friends
Building new relationships and maintaining existing ones are hindered

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Frequently using 'should/must not stand out' type statements
Directly treating the social norm of 'blending in, not standing out' as self-Demands

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-Reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and harsh self-criticism, being overly careful about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessively cares about others' evaluations; repeatedly blames oneself, such as 'I take up too much space'
Freezes in public and stays quiet, reducing movement

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Mind reading others without evidence: 'they must be disliking me'
Attributing inner insecurity to others' attitudes

positive_force: Has some social support (several friends to turn to for help)
Willing to seek help and accept counseling; fairly stable motivation
Able to Identify automatic thoughts and try proposing alternative Interpretations
Willing to try behavioral experiments and reality testing
Has tried self-help strategies such as breathing exercises and positive self-talk
negative_force: Overly concerned about others' opinions; seeks external validation
Significant mind reading and personalization cognitive biases
Social avoidance behaviors reinforce the maintenance of Anxiety
Introjecting the 'do not stand out' social norm as self-Demands
Overly strong self-consciousness, prone to nervous freezing in public

target_behavior.behavior: Social anxiety and avoidance in public places
antecedent: Worries about blocking others' view when watching a film in the cinema
When feeling like the center of attention
target_behavior.core_reason: Mind-reading and negatively predicting others' judgments due to conspicuous height, Introjecting the 'do not stand out' social norm as self-Demands, forming shame and Anxiety.
target_behavior.function: Escaping being judged and shame, gaining short-term safety and psychological relief
target_behavior.consequence: Hard to enjoy activities (e.g., movies), Avoids socializing, impaired building and maintaining of Interpersonal relationships
